items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And he had a little ring, he sold it to me for $40.00, and I never did pay him.

ctx.x: And Hugh Hoskins was Elite Number Two, because I remember the first little diamond ring I got was a little, tiny ring -- the man Tenan (PHONETIC) Jones owned Elite, Numbers One and Two. And he had a little ring, he sold it to me for $40.00, and I never did pay him.
